title: file.modification_approved event data
description: The user approved changing a file git tracks: why it was changed (justification) and their words (approval). sha256 is the hash of the bytes approved, inside the MAC; the state honours the approval only for a file.modified record of the same path and sha256. authority_mac is the machine-bound MAC ledger.append adds; an event without a valid one confers no authority and folds to nothing.
